releases.name: v1.0.2 — persistent user-home state store
releases.body: Default run history now lives at `~/.sibyl/runs.json`, co-located with `~/.sibyl/spaces/` and immune to npm-upgrade wipes. Constructor/`SIBYL_STATE_FILE` override precedence unchanged. Includes v1.0.1's options-surface fixes (strict unknown-key rejection + corrected tuple examples — 1.0.1 was tagged on GitHub only and never published to npm; 1.0.2 supersedes it entirely). 259 tests green, live-verified from foreign cwd: store lands at ~/.sibyl/runs.json.

releases.name: v1.0.1 — loud options rejection + corrected registration examples
releases.body: Fixes a docs-level footgun: the README tuple example showed a `{"options": {...}}` wrapper, but the host passes the tuple's second element **verbatim** as the options object — the wrapper silently fell through to all defaults. Options schema is now `.strict()` (unknown keys → loud DISABLED naming the key), examples corrected to the direct top-level shape, red-first + factory regressions added. 258/258 tests.
First public release: fail-closed 2/3 council voting, dynamic workflow swarm, on-disk provenance status (tools: sibyl_consult, sibyl_swarm, sibyl_status). 255 offline tests. See README.
